title: Santiago · Day 2
subtitle: Van from Hotel Diego de Velázquez · small-crew documentary
summary: Market → hill if cleared → Lastarria → interview holds → Centro on foot → Goran in evening light. All times are local and provisional.

light.label: Sunrise / sunset
light.note: Tuesday 10 November, Santiago. Buildings and the hill can block direct sun earlier.

light.label: Morning exteriors
light.note: Market life first. By the 10:00 lift opening, light is already strong; Andes views face morning backlight and depend on visibility.

light.label: Host / evening
light.note: Aim for soft side or back light for Goran. Keep the final traffic pickups for the lower light before sunset; seek open shade if contrast is still hard.

notices: This combines the 10 November daily report and the inconsistently dated 11 November call sheet. The 13:00 and 14:30–16:30 interview entries are holds, not two confirmed appointments. Producer must reconcile guest, date, duration and travel before departure.

Proposed hotel brief 08:15, van departure 08:30. This brings the brief 15 minutes earlier than the suggested call sheet. Evening coverage follows the report’s 20:30 wrap, rather than the other draft’s 16:30 finish.

Check weather, visibility and access at 07:30. The supplied weather notes conflict with the DMC model; use the current forecast on the day. If the summit is cloudy or media access is not cleared, use the city fallback below.

Hill filming needs advance Parquemet media authorization. Van access is separate and is not assumed. Funicular public service begins 10:00 Tuesday; an entry ticket is not filming approval. If not ascending by 10:20, abandon the hill and protect interview travel.

City fallback: La Vega frontage/cleared market until 09:45, Lastarria 10:15–11:00, then early lunch and interview transfer. Bring Centro coverage forward only if the confirmed interview address and timing allow it.

Transfers are planning allowances, not live traffic or reserved parking. Driver checks legal pickup points and current routing. Numbered pins use photo GPS or published venue maps; address-only stops still have directions. No private apartment or crew contacts are published.

Priority when running late: interviews, Goran with book, newspapers, city wide, fruit, Metro, bank/state-company and traffic. Drop extra brands, fuel detour and additional angles first. Checkboxes save only on this device; they do not sync across the crew.

stops.title: La Vega · fruit and working life
stops.mapQuery: La Vega Central, Dávila Baeza 700, Recoleta, Chile

shots.text: Fruit-stall wide, stacks of produce, working hands, weighing and exchange.
Deliveries, loading and identifiable trucks if active; collect clean ambient sound.

stops.light: Early activity matters more than golden light. Use even covered light for fruit and hands; match exposure at bright entrances.
stops.transfer: Leave by 09:25; allow 15–25 min to the funicular gate, including parking. If late, reduce to one wide and one detail or skip.
stops.notes: Official Tuesday visitor hours 07:00–17:00. Market filming/reportage requires prior coordination through its contact form. Without it, use public street frontage only. This is a new scouting stop with an address link, not a photo GPS pin.

stops.notes: Published Tuesday service 10:00–19:45. Prior Parquemet media authorization is required for the filming visit. If the crew is not ascending by 10:20, switch to Lastarria and protect lunch/interview travel.

stops.title: Cerro San Cristóbal · city scale
stops.address: Cumbre / Terraza Bellavista, Cerro San Cristóbal
stops.mapQuery: Cumbre Cerro San Cristóbal, Parque Metropolitano de Santiago, Chile

shots.text: Locked city wide, slow panorama and one short timelapse.
Andes and city layers if visible; visitors looking out for human scale.

stops.light: At this hour the sun is already high toward the east/northeast. East-facing Andes can be backlit; choose the clearest angle rather than promising sunlit mountains.
stops.transfer: Hard stop 10:50. Allow 40 min for descent, van pickup, transfer and Lastarria unload. Directions identify the viewpoint; road navigation ends at the lower gate.
stops.notes: Pin and reference image come from the earlier photo walk. Clouds, haze or access delays trigger the city fallback. A future clear morning is preferable to spending the interview buffer waiting here.

stops.title: Lastarria · everyday street scenes
stops.address: José Victorino Lastarria, around nos. 264–276, Santiago

shots.text: Historic street wide, café/restaurant fronts, pedestrians and small interactions.
Visible electrical cables and everyday infrastructure where actually encountered.
Scout an open newspaper kiosk; if absent, carry the shot to Centro.

stops.light: Use shaded pavement and doorways as the sun climbs; shoot across the street for readable façades and avoid dappled faces.
stops.transfer: Finish at 12:00. Reserve 12:00–13:00 for quick lunch, travel and setup; exact interview destination can change this cutoff.
stops.notes: Bocanáriz is here for a frontage pickup; do not depend on lunch opening or an interior filming slot. Interview setup takes priority over extra café angles.

Confirmed interview, room tone and relevant hands/book/work details with the contributor.

stops.transfer: The drafts list 13:00 and 14:30–16:30. They are alternative holds until reconciled; both are not assumed to fit. Reserve 16:30–17:10 to reach Centro only if the confirmed address makes it realistic.
stops.notes: The 13:00 location is unconfirmed. The other draft contains a private apartment location, retained off this public site. If both interviews are needed, producer must resolve duration/transfer overlap; trim B-roll rather than compress interviews.

stops.title: Plaza de Armas · press and public life

shots.text: Cathedral/plaza establishing wide, pedestrians, performers and ordinary moments.
Find an open kiosk: newspaper mastheads, actual dated headlines, seller and hands buying/reading.
Metro entrance/logo and people entering; keep station-interior coverage separate unless arranged.

stops.light: Later western light can give side light and readable architecture; choose a shaded edge for people and match exposure between angles.
stops.transfer: Arrange one legal van drop-off for the Centro walking cluster. Allow about 10–15 min walking toward Huérfanos 1270, shooting only quick inserts en route.
stops.notes: Kiosks are a live scout target, not a guaranteed operating stall. Contemporary papers illustrate current press; junta-era coverage still requires the relevant archive/editorial context.

stops.title: Codelco · state-owned company
stops.mapQuery: Codelco Casa Matriz, Huérfanos 1270, Santiago, Chile

shots.text: Legible company sign, building context and the public-facing company-history mural if accessible.

stops.light: Use the street’s available shade/side light; expose the sign cleanly. Keep to two or three useful compositions.
stops.transfer: Allow 10–15 min on foot to Alameda / BancoEstado; if late, take one identifying wide and move on.
stops.notes: Official corporate address. This establishes a state-owned mining company’s headquarters; it is not a mine, oil site or renewable-energy facility. Office interiors are not scheduled.

stops.title: Alameda · bank, Metro and global brands

Metro Universidad de Chile exterior logo, stairs and commuter flow.
McDonald’s at Ahumada 12; add Wendy’s, Starbucks or Krispy Kreme only if actually encountered on the route.
Cars, parking, buses and readable bus-lane markings from a safe public viewpoint.

stops.light: Pick the readable side of the street. Keep moving through hard/shaded patches rather than forcing one exposure for the whole block.

stops.notes: BancoEstado address is Alameda 1111; the verified chain-store exterior is McDonald’s Ahumada 12. Other named brands are opportunistic targets, not confirmed stops. Bank/store/Metro interiors require a separate arrangement.
